quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses, not reviewer conclusions. Direct symmetric, nontransitive label safeguards; no production quiz draw was reproduced.
隙間 safeguards ordinary physical opening/space/interval labels 間/間隔/空き/穴. 差 is not guarded merely because its difference label can be English gap.
スクール and 学校 have identical school titles and deduplicate already; 教室's complete family and actual lesson support school/classes overlap.
少なくとも safeguards inclusive at-least/minimum labels 以上/最低. A minimum wish in せめて does not establish universal interchangeability.

図形 safeguards represented figure/shape labels 図/形/姿/格好/スタイル and graphical 図表. Bodily figure versus geometric figure distinctions remain; this is a conservative broad-English-label precaution, not unrestricted Japanese synonymy.

スケジュール safeguards 予定/計画/時間割/カレンダー and the actual railway-schedule ダイヤ homograph; do not confuse that identity with the diamond entry. 図表/ダイヤ is separately based on ダイヤ's explicit diagram sense, not transitive inference from scheduling.
鈴 safeguards ベル/鐘 without an absolute size partition; 涼む/冷える is a conservative cool-down English precaution while intentional enjoyment versus unwanted chilling remains.
スタート safeguards ordinary start/beginning labels 開始/始まり/始め/初め/最初/始める/始まる and departure 出発/発車; source transitivity and noun/verb differences remain.
酸っぱい/酸性 safeguards English sour/acidic ambiguity; it does not identify tasted sourness with a measured chemical property or justify a bitter-taste pair.
ステージ safeguards actual stage/show/performance labels 舞台/公演/演技/演奏/芝居 and conservatively the level wording of 水準. Game/phase level does not become an unrestricted quality standard.

ストッキング/靴下 is grounded in the broader socks-and-stockings entry. ストップ safeguards 止まる/止める/止す/中止/終了 and the public bus-stop sense against 停留所; a halt is not necessarily completion and an action is not always a place.
素直 safeguards direct obedient/frank/unaffected/straightforward uses of 正直/まっすぐ/自然/普通/利口, including secondary ordinary senses; these are not inherited through one another.

頭脳 safeguards actual brains/intellect/understanding uses of 脳/頭/知能/知恵/理解; no copying of the entire 脳 mind-word exclusion set. 情報 is not intellect merely because English intelligence can mean information.
図表 safeguards 図/表 and separately ダイヤ's diagram sense. Its 図形 pair is declared on 図形; the app honors either declaration symmetrically.

スマート safeguards stylish/slender/deft/clever labels おしゃれ/細い/器用/上手/上手い/賢い/利口. Clever/adroit is a real pinned sense, not forbidden by the appearance lead. A slender build is not automatically the change-event 痩せる.
スチュワーデス and audio-qualified スピーカー have no new guards. Existing reused guards remain unchanged; absence is not independent approval.
sourceAccessLimits: Eighteen new articles and two bounded reuses cover N2:842-N2:861 in a named community list, not an official syllabus.
Twenty principals/forty senses are included, not added again, in the 249-family/581-sense union; two supplemental ダイヤ families preserve distinct identities.

Raw source forms stay verbatim. 少なくとも and 酸っぱい explicitly teach source kana. Rare 棄てる is recognized on unchanged-level N4 捨てる; its blank source gloss remains blank and discarding is an editorial anchor, not recovered intent.
すっきり gains only jlpt:2; existing body/title/tags/five guards remain unchanged. Selected senses 1-4 do not claim that captured senses 5-6 are newly authored or independently N2.
